result:
I’ll inspect the span implementations and their tests, then add copy and pickle support. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
The immutable span wraps OpenTelemetry objects containing locks, and the lazy span’s attribute fallback runs during copy reconstruction before its state exists. I’ll serialize the span’s data and attachments, restore lazy spans without loading them, and add an explicit error for copying live spans.
The first test run produced no-op spans in many existing tests as well as the new ones. I found inherited OpenTelemetry exporter settings that may be interfering, so I’ll rerun the two relevant test files with those settings unset.
Implemented copy and pickle support for immutable, lazy, and no-op spans, plus whole traces.

- Preserves span data and attachments.
- Keeps restored lazy spans unloaded and omits duplicate raw JSON.
- Preserves shallow-copy sharing.
- Rejects deep copy and pickle of live spans with conversion guidance.

Added regression tests. Relevant test files completed with 120 passed and 1 skipped; pytest’s final reporting hook then hit a sandbox permission error. No dependencies installed.

+def _pickle_roundtrip(obj):
+    return pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(obj))

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, _pickle_roundtrip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["immutable", "lazy", "materialized"])
+def test_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, kind):
+    with mlflow.start_span("parent"):
+        with mlflow.start_span("child", span_type=SpanType.LLM) as live:
+            live.set_inputs({"input": [1, 2]})
+            live.set_outputs("output")
+            live.set_status(SpanStatus(SpanStatusCode.ERROR, "error"))
+            live.add_event(SpanEvent("event", timestamp=123, attributes={"key": "value"}))
+    span = live.to_immutable_span()
+    expected = span.to_dict()
+    if kind != "immutable":
+        span = LazySpan(expected, raw_json=json.dumps(expected))
+        if kind == "materialized":
+            assert span.name == "child"
+    attachment = Attachment(content_type="text/plain", content_bytes=b"attachment")
+    span._attachments = {attachment.id: attachment}
+
+    restored = restore(span)
+
+    assert type(restored) is type(span)
+    assert restored is not span
+    if kind != "immutable":
+        assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+        assert restored.__dict__["_raw_json"] is None
+        assert "_span" not in restored.__dict__
+        assert set(span.__getstate__()) == {"span_dict", "attachments"}
+        assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] is (kind == "materialized")
+    assert restored.to_dict() == expected
+    assert restored.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+    assert restored.name == "child"
+    assert restored.parent_id == span.parent_id
+    restored_attachment = restored._attachments[attachment.id]
+    assert restored_attachment is not attachment
+    assert restored_attachment.id == attachment.id
+    assert restored_attachment.content_type == attachment.content_type
+    assert restored_attachment.content_bytes == attachment.content_bytes
+    restored.inputs["input"].append(3)
+    assert span.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, _pickle_roundtrip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_context", [False, True])
+def test_noop_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, with_context):
+    otel_span = (
+        trace_api.NonRecordingSpan(build_otel_context(trace_id=123, span_id=456))
+        if with_context
+        else None
+    )
+    span = NoOpSpan(otel_span)
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert isinstance(restored, NoOpSpan)
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert restored.trace_id == span.trace_id
+    assert restored.name is None
+    assert restored._attributes == {}
+    assert restored._span.get_span_context() == span._span.get_span_context()
+    restored.set_inputs({"input": 1})
+    restored.end()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle.dumps])
+def test_live_span_copy_and_pickle_rejected(restore):
+    with mlflow.start_span("live") as span:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"immutable span with to_immutable_span\(\)"):
+            restore(span)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("immutable", [False, True])
+def test_span_shallow_copy(immutable):
+    with mlflow.start_span("span") as live:
+        span = live.to_immutable_span() if immutable else live
+        restored = copy.copy(span)
+        assert restored is not span
+        assert type(restored) is type(span)
+        assert restored._span is span._span
+        assert restored._attributes is span._attributes
